items.html: *After we explained that the male of Atik Yomin in it is made entirely from the Keter of the new MA, which are the Tastes of MA, and the female in it is made from the five first [Sefirot] of the Keter of BON, which are the Tastes of BON, and also from GAR of Hochma of BON, and from the four first [Sefirot] of Bina of BON, and from the seven Ketarim of ZAT of BON — we shall now explain the matter of Arich Anpin: the ten Sefirot of the male in it are made entirely from the Hochma of the new MA, which are the Nekudot of MA, and the female in it is made from the five lower [Sefirot] of the Keter of BON alone, which expanded and became complete ten Sefirot in the female.
